title: A conjectural construction of Arthur packets in Fargues-Scholze's categorical local Langlands correspondence
summary: We present a conjectural construction of Arthur packets within Fargues-Scholze's framework for the categorical local Langlands correspondence (CLLC). This construction consists of three parts. We first provide an overview the main statement of the CLLC, the underlying moduli stacks -- $\mathrm{Par}_G$ of parameters and $\mathrm{Bun}_G$ of $G$-bundles -- on the two sides of the correspondence, and its relation to representations of reductive p-adic groups.
